description: A meditation timer with interval bells and a soft chime at the end, built on WebAudio — no files needed.

faqs.a: Yes — the browser keeps the timer running in this tab. For longer sits, keep the tab open and your device awake.
faqs.q: Does it keep running in the background?

faqs.a: An interval bell rings every N minutes you choose, helping you notice when your mind has wandered.
faqs.q: What is the interval bell for?

faqs.a: No — the bell is synthesized live with WebAudio, so it works fully offline with no audio files.
faqs.q: Do I need to download any sounds?

howto: Set your session length in minutes.
Optionally set an interval bell every few minutes.
Press Start and settle in; press Pause any time.
A soft chime marks each interval and the end of your sit.
title: Meditation Timer
